description:
Update the lighting definition for all Middle Floor (M.*) spaces in the '4StoreyBuilding' model to reflect a retrofit to suspended LED fixtures. 

Goal: 
1. Navigate to the Internal Loads / Space Properties.
2. For ALL 5 spaces on the Middle Floor (M.S21, M.E22, M.N23, M.W24, M.C25), change:
   - Lighting Power Density (LIGHTING-W/AREA) to 0.72 W/ft2
   - Heat to Return Air (LIGHT-TO-RETURN-AIR) to 0.0
   - Heat to Space (LIGHT-TO-SPACE) to 1.0
3. Run the full annual simulation.
4. Save the project.

Note: Ensure the heat fractions sum to 1.0. Do not modify Ground or Top floor spaces.
